name: Saint wide-shell press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer average 71 g for the exact BB-MT800-PC HOLLOWTECH II press-fit bottom-bracket assembly. The table lists 104.5 mm and 107 mm shell-width options without selecting one weighed width. This PC model is distinct from the existing BB-MT800-PA reference; neither model inherits the other’s weight.
